description: Walk back from `revision` to the root, returning the chain (root first). Each entry has `{ revision, parent, note?, origin?, createdAt }` — `origin: "editor"` marks a revision the user saved from the browser editor. Use this to re-ground after a rewind: read the notes, pick the revision you want to continue from, pass it as `parent` to your next `edit`. Continue a prior design only when the user asked for it — never because it is the newest entry.
name: history
